criteria.2: decision joint gain > 2 SE (SE over pulled team-games)
criteria.3: each of personnel, call and completion > -1 SE
criteria.4: realism (a guardrail): the lead back's carries CRPS and the top two targets' CRPS, R4 - R3 <= +2 SE

dependence: 2026 weeks 13-18 are R1's, R2-H1's and R3's registered games; 2027 is fresh. R1's statistics are game-level, R2-H1's who-got-the-ball on every snap, R3's the quarterback's pull and his line, R4's what happens AFTER a pull (the backup's calls and efficiency, the second unit's workload). Different questions, frozen before any of those games was played; errors are correlated through the shared weeks, so joint passes are not independent confirmations. R4 is fitted on 2016-2024, its rule checked on 2025-2026 weeks 1-12, and tuned on no read (none has been run). R4 plays R3's pull unchanged: R3's verdict is not an input. Any change to R4 or to an R1/R2/R3 file it plays on fails the pinned hashes and moves R4 to fresh games under a new registration.
power: development: the joint gain +0.330 +/- 0.119 a pulled team-game (2025, 102 pulled team-games) and +0.524 +/- 0.149 (2026 weeks 1-12, 48); per-game SD ~1.1-1.2, so at ~125 pulled team-games (2026 weeks 13-18 ~25, 2027 ~100) SE ~0.10 and z ~3.2-5.0: criterion 2 power ~0.9-1.0. Criterion 3: every component positive in both development seasons (personnel +0.26/+0.39, call +0.046/+0.088, completion +0.024/+0.042), so ~0.95 jointly. Criterion 4: R4 - R3 realism -0.007/+0.015 (lead back) and -0.013/-0.013 (top two) with |z| < 0.8, a 2-SE guardrail holding ~0.95 jointly. Overall ~0.8-0.9.

settings.files: play_by_play_<season>.csv.gz, players.csv, injuries_<season>.csv in the read's directory (nflverse, fresh); week 18's kind from the descriptions alone
settings.seed: per game: the last 8 bytes of the nflverse game id, little-endian, mod 2^31

statistics.decision: nfl_coach_r4_eval.collect_with_calls / decision / summarize on every pulled team-game in the window: the starters' cell rates (or xpass for the call) against them moved by R4's frozen effects, log score summed per pulled team-game (positive = R4 better); joint = personnel + call + completion
statistics.realism: nfl_coach_r4_eval.realism: R4 minus R3 per team-game of the CRPS of the real lead back's carries and the real top two targets' targets, both from the same seeds (negative = R4 better)

what: personnel-aware decisions after a quarterback substitution (nfl_coach_sim_r4): the call, completion and interceptions with the backup in, the second unit's carries and targets after a strategic pull, by the kind of pull (injury from the play descriptions and the next week's report, else strategic)
